newsitem.title: USA: US CORPORATE BONDS-Coke bottler sates mkt thirst.
newsitem.headline: US CORPORATE BONDS-Coke bottler sates mkt thirst.

text.p: Corporate supply nearly dried up ahead of Federal Reserve Alan Greenspan's Humphrey Hawkins testimony on Tuesday; however, Coca-Cola Enterprises quenched investor thirst for paper, dealers said.
The world's largest soft drinks bottler poured $750 million in new debt into the market upsizing its A3/A-plus rated offering to meet growing demand for the paper.

The bottler sold $250 million in four-year notes at 30 basis points over Treasuries, $200 million in seven-year notes at 42 basis points and $300 million in 20-year notes at 60 basis points, via lead manager Lehman Brothers.
